backtest_protocol.price_path: entry open → daily close path → exit open; no endpoint smoothing
backtest_protocol.right_censoring: signals without a complete maximum execution window inside the sample are excluded
backtest_protocol.core_tail: strict CORE uses T close as 14:50-15:00 fill proxy; original exit date is unchanged
backtest_protocol.core_tail_quality: live PASS/FAIL/INVALID gate is operational only; historical EOD confidence is not used as a live-quality proxy
backtest_protocol.cost: target-weight turnover × one-way bps; entries, exits and rebalances all counted
backtest_protocol.proxy: proxy gains are discounted; proxy losses are amplified by the same factor
backtest_protocol.observe: observe-only satellite sleeve uses 0.25 production scale
backtest_protocol.satellite_risk_exit: after 3 completed sessions, detect basket return <= -3% or >= 4% at EOD and execute at next open including the gap
backtest_protocol.oos: retrospective holdout starts flat on 2024-01-01; not parameter-independent
backtest_protocol.walk_forward: expanding fixed-policy temporal-stability windows; no in-fold tuning
backtest_protocol.prospective: policy frozen through 2026-08-11; independent observations begin 2026-08-12

cost_stress.etf_haircut_note: proxy 正收益折扣、负收益放大 / weak 剔除；行业指数≠ETF

backtest_display.compare_cn: 建议并排对照「仅核心」；进取 Flex 收益偏高、实盘折扣大
